ideas.description: A community manager installs the Chrome extension and adds saved Reddit searches such as a product name plus “bug,” “review,” or “alternative.” When the user opens Reddit, the extension checks those saved queries, compares returned post identifiers with the last seen snapshot, and places the number of newly matching posts in the browser toolbar badge; clicking it opens a compact list of matching posts for triage.
